purpose: Realistic learner phrasings per intent, run through the same regex compilation the offline simulator and sp.mjs deriveState use. `required` phrasings must all be recognised for their intent (a recall floor that may only rise); `proposed` phrasings are reported, never failed, until faculty decide the vocabulary; `mustNot` entries pin precision (a phrasing that must NOT be credited for the named intents, flags included); `interview` is a full ordinary interview that must leave no checklist row `missed`; `gateScenarios` pin the D14 boundary across phrasings rather than one sentence. Written 2026-10-21 from the Interview Room audit: before this corpus, 77 of 183 realistic Dana phrasings were unrecognised and a discharge-planning question opened the suicide-plan disclosure.
